title: Stefans Content
description: A mod to fill out some gaps in combat accessories, will be used in a future mod pack
body:
Currently adds:
- Mage Cape - +1 spell power
- Fire Cape - +2 fire power
- Frost Cape - +2 frost power
- Arcane Cape - +2 arcane power
- Healing Cape - +2 healing power
- Sparring Gloves - +15% crit chance
- Cloak of Agility - +15% crit chance
- Jeweled Gauntlet - +2 spell power, + crit chance based on all spell powers
- Shark Tooth Necklace - +5 flat armor pen
